title: Grusch: Oppenheimer helped set up UFO secrecy
summary: David Grusch tells of Grusch: Oppenheimer helped set up UFO secrecy, about 1940s at United States (no place named), and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Oppenheimer, somebody purportedly involved in the stand-up of the stuff that I uncovered, right?

plain: David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who says he uncovered secret government programs dealing with recovered craft, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the building of the atomic bomb, is reported to have been involved in setting up those programs in the 1940s. If true, it would tie the secrecy around unexplained craft to the same people behind the atomic bomb.
